name: Track Analysis
author: pedro
summary: Generate missing phrases for loaded USB and Beatport tracks.
description: Analyzes missing phrases in a background process using the loaded track’s native beat grid. Supports USB OneLibrary tracks and completed Beatport downloads, including AAC-LC M4A audio. Publishes phrases to the native display immediately so phrase-aware mods can react during the same load. Preserves populated grids, phrases, cues and waveforms. Requires the loaded-track analysis SDK service, currently qualified on firmware 2.00. Folder-only tracks, encrypted media and HE-AAC are unsupported.
